title: Test task routing against misleading readiness and resources
question: Can the local picker suggest work that does not fit a contributor or has a known live claim?
baseline: scripts/pick_task.py and scripts/task_contracts.py at the checked-out commit.
resources: Python 3.11+ and a CPU laptop. Simulate issue responses locally; no network or GPU is needed.
acceptance: Add at least three new adversarial cases beyond tests/test_task_picker.py.
Use mocked issue responses and synthetic task copies; do not change task readiness or core acceptance rules.
Check declared resource fit, dependency completion, and failure to confirm live availability.
If a case exposes a real defect, report a minimal reproduction and proposed fix separately.
Do not claim the picker enforces agent spending or reserves a task.
evidence: New test outputs and a brief review record.
Time spent, issues found, and limits.
stop_conditions: A fix needs scope changes; report the defect and stop.
deliverable: Adversarial tests and a review note that improve confidence in task selection.
